capabilities: Search indexed note collections for context
extras: Manual features are free; scheduled generation, SMTP email, and background indexing require a purchased activation code (offline Ed25519 verification, no device binding or revocation). Full maintenance source is kept in a private repo. API keys, SMTP passwords, local tokens, and activation codes are stored in the vault's plugin data.json. Some right-click launchers (PowerShell, iflow) are Windows-only, and the local HTTP interface on 127.0.0.1:27123 is off by default.

problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate AI text or images, ground prompts in your own notes, or run AI tasks on a schedule.
